hero.lede: I build secure Java and Angular software for businesses: e-invoicing, ERP systems and multi-tenant platforms that other companies plug into.

projects.head: Selected work
projects.intro: Eight projects, from enterprise platforms to mobile apps. Client work is under NDA, so some of them have no public link.

smartdigidocs.title: SmartDigiDocs
smartdigidocs.summary: A document platform for electronic invoicing and payments: standards validation, tenant isolation and interoperability with client systems.
points: Designed the QR code validation module: it processes over 5,000 documents and works with more than 100 client systems.
Built PEPPOL and EN 16931 XML validation, and a module that generates SEPA payment codes.
Designed a multi-tenant service architecture on OAuth2, SAML and JWT, with RBAC/ABAC, consolidated audit trails and zero-trust boundaries between tenants.
Added automated SAST and DAST security scans to the Jenkins and Azure DevOps pipelines.
Managed Active Directory sign-in and access through JNDI Realm and LDAP.

erp.title: APIZ & Compiere ERP
erp.summary: New features and complex changes on two ERP products, from functional analysis with business teams to deployment.
points: Built features in Java/JEE and Spring Boot on the backend, Angular and TypeScript on the frontend.
Rewrote slow SQL on PostgreSQL and Oracle, sharply cutting the response times of critical modules.
Built the APIs that connect the ERP to other business applications.
Set up automated GitLab CI/CD pipelines running on Docker and Kubernetes.

health.where: ISI, University of Tunis El Manar
health.title: Digital health platform
health.summary: Patients find a doctor, book an appointment in real time and keep their medical records in one secure place.
points: Designed the REST API in Spring Boot with JWT authentication, role-based access and HTTPS.
Built the Flutter app for iOS and Android so patients see appointments and records on their phone.
Tuned the Spring Data JPA persistence layer for complex medical data under concurrent load.
Added real-time notifications for appointment reminders and booking confirmations.

lei.title: The Lei Studio
lei.summary: A single-page website for a Tunis nail salon: services, prices, opening hours, a map, and one-tap WhatsApp and phone buttons.
points: All texts and prices live in one data file, so updates never touch the components.
Every push to main builds and deploys to GitHub Pages through GitHub Actions.

smuppy.title: Smuppy
smuppy.summary: A social network for sport: a feed and stories, short video reels, local sports events to join, and a map that routes you to nearby gyms.
smuppy.alt: Five Smuppy app screens: an event page, the social feed with stories, the splash screen, a map route to a gym, and a video reel

about.head: About me
p: I'm a full stack developer from Tunisia with three years of professional Java and Angular work. I care about clean architecture and the unglamorous parts of software: the validation rule that stops a bad invoice, the access check that keeps one tenant out of another's data, the SQL query that makes a report load in seconds.
I finished a master's in software development alongside my job, and I use AI coding tools every day. One thing about me: I can't sleep with a bug left in my project.
